# Bindings: entities, event types and pipelines

What the pipeline's messages mean, loaded the same way by Java (`io.realy.scoring.binding`) and Python (`realy.bindings`). How to add an event type or a field: [dev/schemas.md](../dev/schemas.md).

## Entities

Order is the Flink job's keyed-stage order (append only).

| # | Entity | Id | Owned by | Entity enum |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 0 | `customer` | u64 |  | CUSTOMER |
| 1 | `card` | u64 | customer | CARD |
| 2 | `device` | u64 |  | DEVICE |
| 3 | `ip` | u32 |  | IP |
| 4 | `merchant` | u64 |  | MERCHANT |
| 5 | `terminal` | u64 | merchant | TERMINAL |
| 6 | `payee` | u64 |  | PAYEE |
| 7 | `account` | u64 | customer |  |
| 8 | `txn` | u64 | customer |  |

## Pipelines

| Pipeline | Namespace | Partition key | Event types | Exact entities | Topics |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `payments` | (default) | customer | `payment` (scored), `payment_initiation` (fold), `device_context` (fold), `payee_check` (fold), `sca_result` (fold), `payment_submission` (fold), `payment_status` (fold) | customer, card, account, txn | events: `payments.events.raw`, decisions: `payments.decisions`, labels: `payments.labels`, assembled: `payments.events.assembled` |
